explication: raylib is a C game-programming library. The principal workflow is: an application uses the public API to initialize a platform window, process input and timing, update camera or game state, issue 2D/3D drawing and audio calls, and present results through a graphics backend. Core modules cover rendering, assets, text, models, audio, mathematics, and input helpers. The graph preserves documented platform, OpenGL, software-rendering, VR, shader, and media-format capabilities; some links are inferred from module organization because only sampled excerpts were available.
